params.name: input
params.label: Input
params.description: The geometry whose point attribute is changed by comparing each point with the points around it.

params.name: attribute
params.label: Attribute
params.description: The point attribute to operate on; must already exist. Works on floats, integers and vectors; integers stay whole.

params.name: mode
params.label: Mode
params.description: Diffuse smooths toward neighbours, Concentrate sharpens away from them, Migrate moves value along Direction, Bleed decays to zero, Align and Lead turn vectors, Charge accumulates and discharges.

params.name: neighbourhood
params.label: Neighbourhood
params.description: Which points count as neighbours: those within Rings edges on the mesh, those within Radius in space (across folds too), or every point.

params.name: rings
params.label: Rings
params.description: How many edge rings out from a point count as its neighbours. More rings spread the effect wider per evaluation.

params.name: radius
params.label: Radius
params.description: Distance in world units within which points count as neighbours, regardless of mesh connectivity.

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.description: Strength of each evaluation, 0 to 1: the fraction of the way toward the target, the fraction moved or decayed, or the charge added per step. Inside a simnet it acts as a rate.

params.name: direction
params.label: Direction
params.description: A vector point attribute giving the direction value flows in Migrate mode; neighbours in front of each point receive what it gives up.

params.name: group
params.label: Group
params.description: Only points in this group are changed; neighbours outside it are still read. Empty changes every point.

params.name: target
params.label: Target
params.description: What vectors turn toward: the neighbours' average, the whole geometry's average, the Constant vector, the Source attribute, or the vector's own projection onto the surface.

params.name: constant
params.label: Constant
params.description: The fixed direction vectors turn toward when Target is Constant.

params.name: source
params.label: Source
params.description: In Align with Target set to Attribute, the vector attribute to turn toward. In Lead, a number weighting each neighbour's influence; empty weighs all equally.

params.name: release
params.label: Release
params.description: Threshold at which a point's charge discharges, split evenly among its neighbours. Higher stores more before firing; 0 never discharges.
